title: Flash backup 7.2 - U15 for the clip, TP33 for the reset hold
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~97 px/mm in this crop)
caption: The clip goes on U15 with its pin-1 lead on pin 1 (the two dots): leads on 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 only. The CC3220 is held in reset at TP33, never at R321's right pad, which is the 3.3 V rail.

callouts.label: U15 pin 1, CS#: the clip's pin-1 lead
callouts.note: Bottom-left leg, by the two silkscreen dots. Pin positions by continuity (J-108, J-109). Lead to the reader's CS.

callouts.label: U15 pin 2, DO: to the reader's MISO
callouts.note: Data out of the flash (J-108: beeper to P7).

callouts.label: U15 pin 3, WP#: no lead
callouts.note: Write protect, only guards the status register (XM25QH64A datasheet p. 5). The clip contacts it, but its lead stays unconnected.

callouts.label: U15 pin 4, GND: the reader's GND; the orientation check
callouts.note: Beeps to JP5 pin 2 (J-080, J-108). The clip lead that beeps here proves the clip is the right way round.

callouts.label: U15 pin 5, DI: to the reader's MOSI
callouts.note: Data into the flash (J-109: beeper to P6).

callouts.label: U15 pin 6, CLK: to the reader's CLK
U15 pin 7, HOLD#: no lead; about 3.3 V when powered
callouts.note: HOLD# low would stall every read; the board pulls it up, about 10 kOhm to VCC (J-109). Measured powered at step 8.3.

callouts.label: U15 pin 8, VCC: no lead (the board feeds it); 3.3 V check
callouts.note: On U17's 3.3 V output (J-110). The clip's VCC lead stays off: a reader feeding it would back-feed U17 (J-076). The meter's 3.3 V point.

callouts.label: U1 pin 32, nRESET
callouts.note: The last pin of U1's bottom edge. Its trace runs past C331, C322 and R321 to TP33 (raptox, J-203).

callouts.label: C322: nRESET's filter cap
callouts.note: Its left pad on nRESET (beeper, J-204); the other pad to GND (likely).

callouts.label: R321 left pad: nRESET (same net as TP33)
callouts.note: Beeps fully to TP33 (J-204). An alternative hold point, but TP33 holds a probe better.

callouts.label: R321 right pad: 3.3 V. NEVER the ground probe
callouts.note: Beeps fully to U15 pin 8 (J-205). Grounding it would short U17's output (J-208).

callouts.label: TP33: the reset hold, probe to GND
callouts.note: U1's nRESET (J-203). 9.7 kOhm to 3.3 V through R321, nothing drives it (J-204): held to GND it draws about 0.34 mA, and the CC3220 never starts.
